use bytes::Bytes;

pub const REMOTE_HANDLE_SIZE: i64 = 32;

pub type remote_handle_t = Bytes;

pub mod nfs_support_program {
    pub const PROGRAM: u32 = 300001;

    pub mod nfs_support_v1 {
        pub const VERSION: u32 = 1;
        pub const NFS_PING: u32 = 0;
    }

}

/// Metadata-only projection; the terminal opaque body remains in caller storage.
pub type remote_handle_tMetadata = onc_rpc_xdr::OpaqueLength<{ REMOTE_HANDLE_SIZE as usize }>;

/// Alternate argument representation retaining multiple owners for one terminal opaque body.
pub type remote_handle_tSegments = onc_rpc_xdr::OpaqueSegments<{ REMOTE_HANDLE_SIZE as usize }>;
